faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the One Stop Centre Erode Senior Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Senior Counsellor post is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Counsellor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Social Work, Counselling Psychology, or Development Management from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years of experience in issues related to violence against women is required.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are residents of Erode District are eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 22,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the One Stop Centre Erode Senior Counsellor vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Counsellor.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website, www.erode.nic.in, or through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
